authorityCeiling.basis: Boundary: "Candidate generation is not self-approval." QCM generates candidates; it cannot approve or execute them, so its ceiling is recommend.
Boundary quote: "Candidate generation is not self-approval." Generating candidates without approving them maps to recommend in the Section 3.3 authority vocabulary.

capabilityFamilies.basis: Role quote: "Generates candidate team, model, memory, and communication topologies."

lifecycleStages.basis: Section 3.3 defines lifecycleMask as workflow stage and completion state but names no stages. The paper assigns no lifecycle stages to QCM.

memoryPlanes.basis: Candidate teams, models, memories, and topologies are working-scope proposals, not stored memory; the boundary forbids self-approval, so no stored plane is claimed.

outputClasses.basis: Role quote: "Generates candidate team, model, memory, and communication topologies." A generated candidate topology is delivered as an artifact.

permittedRoutes.basis: The paper defines routeMask semantics in Sections 3.2 and 3.3 but names no per-organ routes for QCM.

paperRole: Generates candidate team, model, memory, and communication topologies.
paperSource: N-Cell position paper, Section 4 mapping table, https://ncell-position-paper.pages.dev/, accessed 2026-11-14.
